headline: NYY @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 5.05 at BAL 4.01, with a projected total of 9.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: NYY moved -0.78 runs while BAL moved +0.09, changing the projected margin by -0.87 runs. The projected total fell -0.69, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +15.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ryan Weathers has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Cody Bellinger, Samuel Basallo, Aaron Judge, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Taylor Ward, Coby Mayo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
